title: FasTrac Mixer Trailer

onscreen_lines.desc: FasTrac 500 Concrete Mixer Trailer Specifications Refer to the Specification Sheet in the Bid Attachments tab for all trailer dimension and construction requirements. Note: Quoted unit shall meet or exceed all specifications listed. Vendor shall clearly identify the mixer model being offered and provide complete product specifications with its bid. Delivery Pricing shall include all shipping, freight, handling, delivery, and unloading charges. Inspection and Acceptance The unit shall be subject to inspection and acceptance by SAWS upon delivery. Acceptance shall occur only after SAWS verifies that the equipment meets all solicitation requirements and is free from defects or damage. Any nonconforming, damaged, or defective equipment shall be repaired or replaced by the Vendor at no additional cost to SAWS. Warranty Vendor shall provide the manufacturer's standard warranty for all equipment and components furnished under this solicitation. Warranty coverage shall be a minimum of one (1) year from the date of SAWS acceptance, covering defects in materials and workmanship. Vendor shall include complete warranty information, including coverage terms and duration, with its bid submission.
